rubric.role_summary: Director-level guest experience role at a romantic luxury retreat, designing and operating the end-to-end guest journey and service standards across guest-facing teams.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Director-level guest experience role at a romantic luxury retreat, designing and operating the end-to-end guest journey and service standards across guest-facing teams.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience leading a team.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Has designed a service system, rather than only operated one, and can identify what it replaced and what measurably improved.
- Has maintained a standard across a team without personally supervising every shift.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Whitwell, TN area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

must_haves.source_quote: You have held a standard across a team you did not personally supervise every shift. Passing looks like: a specific example where quality held while you were off property.

preferences.requirement: Has designed a service system, rather than only operated one, and can identify what it replaced and what measurably improved.
preferences.source_quote: You have designed a service system, not just run one. Passing looks like: you can walk us through a workflow, SOP set, or communication sequence you built from scratch, show what it replaced, and tell us what got measurably better.

preferences.requirement: Has maintained a standard across a team without personally supervising every shift.
preferences.source_quote: You have held a standard across a team you did not personally supervise every shift. Passing looks like: a specific example where quality held while you were off property.

Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

soft_requirements: Ability to identify the most meaningful moments in a guest stay and prioritize them.
Willingness to test an imperfect first version with guests and revise it quickly.

location.reason: Already one location rule; requirement text restated in the single-location form.

removed_criteria.requirement: Uses AI daily and can give a concrete example of something it helped them build, including the tool and result.
removed_criteria.source_quote: You use AI daily, unprompted, and you can show us something real it helped you build. Passing looks like: you name the thing, the tool, and the result.
removed_criteria.reason: Requires candidate confirmation (authorization, citizenship, clearance, travel, schedule, or similar); not observable in a profile.

reduced_criteria.extracted_requirement: Has maintained a standard across a team without personally supervising every shift.
reduced_criteria.reason: Team leadership is observable from titles; maintaining standards without supervision is not.
